title: 第24章  杀妖手段，杀你也凑合
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
苏定安脸色惨白，眼底涌出毫不掩饰的惊恐。

    他在青州镇魔司待了七年，而眼前这人，却是镇魔司通缉令上挂了十年都没抓到的狠角色。

    据说此人修炼邪功，在大乾各地犯下血案，以活人精血喂养自身，一身修为深不可测。

    他下意识后退一步，却发现一道挺拔身影出现在视线之中。

    只见陆渊风轻云淡地向前走去，只身来到了那群长生教徒面前。

    阎九渊慵懒地抬起头，眼中精光在陆渊身上停了一瞬，然后便收了回去，自顾自扣起了指甲缝。

    “看来就是你杀了我手下那两个副坛，行，还敢主动站出来，不孬。”

    他的嗓音尖细，带着几分阴柔，听上去就让人难受。

    “趁着还没开打，容我多嘴问一句......我们长生教的人就该死吗？”

    陆渊没说话。

    阎九渊也不在意，自顾自继续说道：“刘韫死了，柳青丝也死了，刘韫我不在乎，不过是个棋子，死就死了。”

    “可柳青丝......她那一身合欢功还是我教的，虽说没学到精髓，但日常用着也算顺手。”

    “可忽然就被你杀了，我这心里，还真有点不落忍。”

    枯瘦身躯从太师椅上坐了起来，指节敲着扶手，发出笃笃声响。

    “我们是贼，你是官，落在你手上，收押，监禁，随你处置，可杀人——”

    “这位大人，难道长生教的人就该死吗？”

    他的姿态依旧慵懒，可周围那些灰衣教徒们却各自握紧了兵刃，气息开始攀升。

    “你废话太多。”

    “他们不死难道我死？”

    陆渊抬起右手，五指微张，晶芒闪烁间一道锋棱晶刺瞬间凝结。

    下一瞬，一道晶刺疾射而出。

    当先的那个灰衣教徒甚至还没反应过来，就感到胸口一凉，被晶刺贯穿心脏。

    整个过程快如惊雷，直到那人倒在地上，其余教徒才反应过来。

    咔嚓！

    太师椅扶手被捏成木渣。

    阎九渊眼瞳迸射冷光，发出阴狠咆哮。

    “你竟敢当着我的面杀人？！”

    说话间，那枯瘦的身躯猛地从太师椅上弹起。

    十指如钩，指尖泛着暗红色的血光，朝着陆渊面门狠狠抓下。

    这是他修炼了数十年的邪功——阴煞血爪，专破横练硬功，沾之即伤，中者必死。

    “不止如此，我还要杀了你！”

    陆渊不退反进，双掌被灵晶覆盖，猛地打了上去。

    嘭！

    两人対掌之下飞沙走石。
content_en:
Su Ding'an's face turned pale, and there was undisguised horror in his eyes.

    He had been in the Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division for seven years, but the man in front of him was a ruthless character who had been on the Demon Suppression Division's wanted list for ten years but had not been caught.

    It is said that this person practiced evil arts, committed murders in various places in Daqian, fed himself with the essence and blood of living people, and his cultivation was unfathomable.

    He subconsciously took a step back, only to find a tall figure appearing in his sight.

    Lu Yuan was seen walking forward calmly and came to the group of Immortal Cultists alone.

    Yan Jiuyuan lazily raised his head, his eyes focused on Lu Yuan for a moment, then he took it back and picked up his fingernails.

    "It seems that you are the one who killed the two assistants under me. Okay, you still dare to stand up. It's not a bad thing."

    His voice was high-pitched and somewhat feminine, which made people uncomfortable to listen to.

    "While the fight hasn't started yet, let me ask one more question... Do we, the people of the Immortality Cult, deserve to die?"

    Lu Yuan said nothing.

    Yan Jiuyuan didn't care, and continued: "Liu Yun is dead, Liu Qingsi is dead, I don't care about Liu Yun, he is just a chess piece, he will die if he dies."

    "But Liu Qingsi... I taught her the Hehuan Kung Fu. Although she didn't learn the essence, she can still use it in daily life."

    "But being killed by you all of a sudden makes me feel a little bit unbearable."

    The thin body sat up from the Taishi chair, tapping the armrest with his knuckles, making a clicking sound.

    "We are thieves and you are an official. If we fall into your hands, we can detain and imprison you. You can do whatever you want, including killing people -"

    "My lord, do the people of the Immortality Sect deserve to die?"

    His posture was still lazy, but the gray-clothed cultists around him gripped their weapons tightly, and their aura began to rise.

    "You talk too much."

    "If they don't die, will I die?"

    Lu Yuan raised his right hand, his fingers slightly spread, and a sharp crystal thorn condensed instantly in the flash of crystal light.

    The next moment, a crystal thorn shot out.

    Before the gray-clothed cultist could even react, he felt a chill in his chest and a crystal thorn penetrated his heart.

    The whole process was as fast as thunder, and the other believers didn't react until the man fell to the ground.

    Click!

    The armrests of the Grand Master's chair were crushed into pieces.

    Yan Jiuyuan's eyes flashed with cold light and he roared viciously.

    "How dare you kill someone in front of me?!"

    As he spoke, the skinny body suddenly jumped up from the Grand Master's chair.

    His ten fingers were like hooks, and his fingertips were glowing with dark red blood, and he clawed hard at Lu Yuan's face.

    This is an evil skill that he has been practicing for decades - the Yin Evil Blood Claw, which specializes in breaking and practicing hard skills. If it touches it, it will be injured, and those who are hit will die.

    "Not only that, I will kill you!"

    Lu Yuan did not retreat but instead advanced. His palms were covered with spiritual crystals and he struck hard.

    Bang!

    Sand and rocks flew under the palms of the two men.
title_en: Chapter 24: The method of killing monsters is just as good as killing you.
